# Production Security

- Validate all request inputs.
- Enforce auth and ownership server-side.
- Use strict CORS based on config.
- Use security headers.
- Prevent NoSQL injection.
- Do not log secrets or sensitive document content.
- Add negative tests for high-risk behavior.
